title: Minions
loyaltyLow: Loyalty is low. Consider a pizza party.
table.columns.name: Name
course.henchmanTrack: Henchman track: from minion to henchman in six weeks
uniformHelp: Jumpsuits come in one colour, and choosing it is not part of the job. Sizes run small since the incident with the industrial dryer, so order one size up and keep the receipt.
pizzaBudgetExceeded: Pizza budget exceeded. Somebody ordered anchovies.
reviewSaved: Review saved. {{name}} has been told it went well.
onboardingIntro: New minions spend their first week shadowing a senior minion, learning the tunnel routes and where not to stand during demonstrations. Assign a mentor now; minions without one tend to wander into the shark tank area.
fireConfirm: Let {{name}} go? They keep their jumpsuit but lose lair access immediately. Their unused pizza budget returns to the pool, and the minions will talk about this for weeks.
rosterEmpty: No minions yet. A lair is only as good as its staff.
